name: Four Seasons Resort Vail
positioning: Contemporary alpine lodge at the front door to Vail Village, a short walk from the base of Vail Mountain
best_for: Travelers who want a base at the front door to Vail Village
Guests who want a year-round heated outdoor pool
Guests who want a spa with 13 treatment rooms

facts.text: The resort has 110 rooms in total.
The resort is at the front door to Vail Village, a short walk from the base of Vail Mountain.
The design is a contemporary alpine lodge with peaked roofs, wooden beams and stone exterior.
Tavernetta Vail is the resort's Italian restaurant.
The Remedy serves modern mountain cuisine with craft cocktails.
The heated outdoor pool is open every day of every season.
The Spa has been newly renovated.

highlights.text: Premier Rooms have gas-burning stone fireplaces.
The Pool Bar serves the resort's signature Haute Chocolate.
The Chalet concierge team can assist with ski lessons.
The resort offers a complimentary shuttle service around Vail Village.
Condé Nast Traveler says the smallest rooms are just under 600 square feet.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the hotel isn't located steps from the ski lift.
The outdoor pool is open from 7:00 am to 9:00 pm daily.
Denver International Airport is 2 hours by car from the resort.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
